sections.Profile:
"Queen of Hearts" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1952. Designed by Wayne Neyens, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and five gobble holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
